title: Verifiable Intent layer stack with lifetimes
caption: Each layer binds the key that signs the next through the cnf claim. Immediate mode stops at L2 with final values; Autonomous mode adds L3a for the network and L3b for the merchant, linked by checkout_hash. Lifetimes are the spec recommendations.
alt: Flowchart from top to bottom. L1, signed by the issuer, typ sd+jwt, about one year, binds the user key. It leads either to L2 Immediate, typ kb-sd-jwt, 15 minutes, final checkout and payment values, user present; or to L2 Autonomous, typ kb-sd-jwt+kb, 24 hours to 30 days, constraints and the agent key. L2 Autonomous leads to L3a, payment mandate to the network, and L3b, checkout mandate to the merchant, each 5 minutes recommended and 1 hour maximum. L3a transaction_id equals L3b checkout_hash.
